checksum_provenance: Every local Hugging Face file was read in full and matched against pinned upstream LFS SHA-256 (or Git blob SHA-1 for non-LFS files). MD5 was computed locally on those verified bytes; the upstream does not publish MD5. SAM3 downloads use the pinned ModelScope facebook/sam3 repository; its SHA-256 and sizes match the already verified files. The two RoboTwin dataset ZIPs were read in full; local SHA-256 and sizes match the pinned Hugging Face dataset LFS metadata, with MD5 computed from those verified bytes.
